evals.name: Clear single-SO pricing in QAS → light
evals.prompt: Score depth for the fixture ticket after triage fields provided.
evals.expected_output: depth light; next_skill pricing-diagnostic; no defect-pattern-analysis.

assertions.name: depth_light
assertions.description: depth.json depth is light and total <= 10 (or heuristic shortcut documented).

evals.name: Billing no accounting doc in prod → standard or deep
evals.prompt: Score depth for billing/AR posting failure in production.
evals.expected_output: depth standard or deep; handoff billing-ar-error-analyzer; red flag prod-posting.

assertions.name: handoff_billing_ar
assertions.description: next_skill is billing-ar-error-analyzer (not replaced by a different diagnostic).

evals.name: Cluster of 8 credit blocks → deep + pattern nudge
evals.prompt: Score depth for primary of an 8-ticket same-root credit cluster.
evals.expected_output: depth deep (or forced by cluster); also_consider includes defect-pattern-analysis; diagnose handoff still credit RCA path.

assertions.name: cluster_flag
assertions.description: red_flags includes cluster-ge-5 or equivalent note; also_consider has defect-pattern-analysis.

assertions.name: diagnostic_not_replaced
assertions.description: diagnose_handoff remains the routing-matrix credit/RCA skill, not replaced by pattern-analysis alone.
